fsm_states_sdram.name: Power Applied
fsm_states_sdram.description: Initial state at power-on; RESET# LOW, CKE LOW.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Reset Procedure
fsm_states_sdram.description: RESET# asserted LOW; CKE LOW; internal logic reset.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Initialization
fsm_states_sdram.description: Awaiting MRS sequence and ZQCL after RESET# deassertion.

fsm_states_sdram.name: ZQ Calibration
fsm_states_sdram.description: ZQCL triggers calibration engine; tZQinit required for first calibration.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Idle
fsm_states_sdram.description: All banks precharged; MR0..MR3 programmed. Ready for ACT/REF/SRE/MRS/ZQCL/ZQCS/PDE/RESET.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Refreshing
fsm_states_sdram.description: Auto Refresh in progress; tRFC must elapse.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Self Refresh
fsm_states_sdram.description: Entered by SRE; DRAM generates own refresh.

fsm_states_sdram.name: MRS / MPR / Write Leveling
fsm_states_sdram.description: Mode register write or feature sub-state from Idle.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Activating
fsm_states_sdram.description: ACT command latched; tRCD before first column command.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Bank Active
fsm_states_sdram.description: One or more banks have an open row.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Reading
fsm_states_sdram.description: Read burst in flight; DQ driven by DRAM at RL = AL + CL.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Writing
fsm_states_sdram.description: Write burst in flight; DQ sunk by DRAM at WL = AL + CWL.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Reading + AutoPrecharge
fsm_states_sdram.description: RDA: read burst followed by auto-PRE.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Writing + AutoPrecharge
fsm_states_sdram.description: WRA: write burst followed by auto-PRE after tWR.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Precharging
fsm_states_sdram.description: PRE / PREA in progress; tRP before next ACT.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Active Power-Down
fsm_states_sdram.description: CKE LOW with bank open; tXP to exit.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Precharge Power-Down
fsm_states_sdram.description: CKE LOW with all banks precharged; Fast (tXP) or Slow (tXPDLL) exit per MR0 A12.

fsm_hints.trigger: Power-up -> RESET_n -> DLL reset + ZQ calibration + MRS (MR0..MR6) -> VrefDQ training -> READY.
fsm_hints.rule: A bank must be ACTIVE (row open, tRCD met) before a column READ/WRITE; PRECHARGE (tRP) closes the row. Bank-group timing (tCCD_S/L, tRRD_S/L, tWTR_S/L) governs back-to-back accesses.
fsm_hints.gear_down: In gear-down mode (MR3) command/address is sampled at 1/2 rate with a synchronization pulse.

anti_deadlock_rule: Controller shall honour all timing parameters (tRCD, tRP, tRAS, tRC, tRRD, tFAW, tWR, tWTR, tRTP, tCCD, tRFC, tREFI, tMRD, tMOD, tCKE, tCKESR, tXP, tXPDLL, tXS, tXSDLL, tZQinit, tZQoper, tZQCS, tDLLK, tCKSRE, tCKSRX, tPRPDEN, tACTPDEN, tWRPDEN, tRDPDEN, tREFPDEN, tMRSPDEN, tIS, tIH) between successive commands. Violating these parameters causes undefined DRAM behaviour with no error indication.
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: RESET_n asserted, then the JESD79-4 power-up sequence: stabilize supplies (VPP then VDD/VDDQ at 1.2 V), CKE HIGH, DLL reset, ZQ calibration, MRS of MR0..MR6, and VrefDQ training before the device is ready for normal commands.

default_ready_state_recommendation.idle: Banks precharged (IDLE), DLL locked, ODT parked (Rtt_PARK), awaiting ACTIVATE; periodic REFRESH within tREFI.
default_ready_state_recommendation.refresh: Issue all-bank or per-bank REFRESH within tREFI; tRFC per Fine Granularity Refresh mode (1x/2x/4x).

configurations.name: UDIMM
configurations.description: Unbuffered DIMM; DRAMs directly on the host bus.

configurations.name: RDIMM
configurations.description: Registered DIMM; an RCD re-clocks command/address.

configurations.name: LRDIMM
configurations.description: Load-reduced DIMM; RCD + Data Buffers (DB) isolate command/address and data.

timing_dependency_rule: tRCD between ACTIVATE and the first column access; tRP after PRECHARGE before the next ACTIVATE; tRAS minimum row-active time; tRC = tRAS + tRP same-bank ACTIVATE period; tRFC after REFRESH; tWR write recovery; bank-group tCCD_S/L, tRRD_S/L, tWTR_S/L; tFAW four-activate window; tREFI average refresh interval.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_POWER_UP
fsm_states_controller.description: Drive RESET# LOW, CKE LOW; ramp VDD/VDDQ; wait ≥ 200 µs after power stable.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_RESET_REL
fsm_states_controller.description: Deassert RESET#; wait 500 µs; bring CK stable; raise CKE HIGH with NOP/DES on command bus; wait tXPR.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_MR_PROGRAM
fsm_states_controller.description: MRS to MR2 (SR temperature, CWL, Rtt_WR) → MR3 (MPR disabled) → MR1 (DLL, Rtt_Nom, AL) → MR0 (BL, CL, WR, DLL Reset=1) → ZQCL → wait tDLLK and tZQinit.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_IDLE
fsm_states_controller.description: Periodically issue REF to maintain refresh; track tREFI and tFAW; schedule ZQCS periodically.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_ACTIVATE
fsm_states_controller.description: Issue ACT to open a row in target bank; respect tRCD before first column command; respect tRRD / tFAW for multi-bank activates.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_READ
fsm_states_controller.description: Issue RD / RDA at RL = AL + CL; receive DQ + DQS edge-aligned from DRAM; honour tCCD between column commands.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_WRITE
fsm_states_controller.description: Issue WR / WRA at WL = AL + CWL; drive DQ + DQS centred; honour tWR before precharge; honour tWTR before read.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_PRECHARGE
fsm_states_controller.description: Issue PRE (single) or PREA (all) to close row; wait tRP before next ACT to that bank.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_REFRESH
fsm_states_controller.description: Issue REF when all banks idle; wait tRFC; resume.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_SELF_REFRESH
fsm_states_controller.description: Issue SRE when system is idle; optionally stop CK after tCKSRE; on wake-up, restart CK, raise CKE, wait tCKSRX + tXS, issue ZQCL, wait tDLLK + tZQoper.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_POWER_DOWN
fsm_states_controller.description: Lower CKE in Bank Active (APD) or Idle (PPD); resume via CKE HIGH + tXP / tXPDLL.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_WL_TRAIN
fsm_states_controller.description: Enter Write Leveling (MR1 A7=1); sweep DQS delay until 0→1 transition observed on DQ feedback; exit (MR1 A7=0).

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_RD_TRAIN
fsm_states_controller.description: Enter MPR (MR3 A2=1); issue RD/RDA; receive predefined pattern; sweep DQ sampling phase to find optimal window; exit (MR3 A2=0).

fsm_transitions_major.description: Initial entry; tINIT ≥ 200 µs after power stable.

fsm_transitions_major.trigger: RESET# rising + 500 µs + CKE rising + tXPR
fsm_transitions_major.description: Standard init sequence; MR2 → MR3 → MR1 → MR0 → ZQCL → tDLLK + tZQinit → Idle.
Read burst on DQ at RL = AL + CL; back to Bank Active.
Write burst at WL = AL + CWL; back to Bank Active after tWTR/tCCD.

fsm_transitions_major.target: Reading + AutoPrecharge → Precharging → Idle (if last bank)
Writing + AutoPrecharge → Precharging → Idle (if last bank)
fsm_transitions_major.description: Auto-precharge after tWR from last data beat.
tRP before next ACT to same bank.
CKE LOW with REF command code; DRAM holds itself in SR.
SRX; DLL must re-lock (tDLLK) before commands requiring DLL.

fsm_transitions_major.trigger: MRS (Idle, all banks precharged, tRP met)
fsm_transitions_major.description: tMRD between MRS; tMOD before non-MRS.
Exit via PDX + tXP (fast) or tXPDLL (slow).
Asynchronous reset; tRESET ≥ 100 ns at stable power.

fsm_states_bank.name: IDLE
fsm_states_bank.description: All rows precharged; the bank awaits an ACTIVATE.

fsm_states_bank.name: ACTIVATING
fsm_states_bank.description: ACTIVATE issued; the row opens (bank group BG, bank BA, row); wait tRCD.

fsm_states_bank.name: ACTIVE
fsm_states_bank.description: A row is open; READ/WRITE column accesses are allowed.

fsm_states_bank.name: PRECHARGING
fsm_states_bank.description: PRECHARGE issued; the row closes; wait tRP before the next ACTIVATE.

fsm_states_device.name: RESET / INIT
fsm_states_device.description: RESET_n + the JESD79-4 power-up / initialization sequence; DLL reset; ZQ calibration; MRS of MR0..MR6.

fsm_states_device.name: VREFDQ_TRAINING
fsm_states_device.description: Controller-directed VrefDQ training (MR6) centers the on-die DQ reference.

fsm_states_device.name: SELF_REFRESH
fsm_states_device.description: CKE LOW self-refresh; the DRAM refreshes itself (ASR / LP modes).

fsm_states_device.name: POWER_DOWN
fsm_states_device.description: Precharge / active power-down (CKE LOW); Maximum Power Saving Mode for deep idle.

bank_group_rule: Accesses to DIFFERENT bank groups can issue at the short delay tCCD_S, while accesses WITHIN the SAME bank group incur the longer tCCD_L. The bank-group split (tCCD_S/L, tRRD_S/L, tWTR_S/L) lets DDR4 hide internal array recovery time at high data rates.
